title: Synchronize universal direct-image ranks without a structure-sheaf unit
statement: Let $f:X\to S$ and $g:T\to S$ be morphisms of schemes and $E$ an $\mathcal O_X$-module. If $\mathrm{PicardUniversalSingleRankMatch}(f,E,E,g)$ and $\mathrm{PicardUniversalSingleRankMatch}(f,E,E^\vee,g)$ [def-sc-picard-universal-single-rank-match] hold, then $\mathrm{PicardUniversalRankMatch}(f,E,g)$ [def-sc-picard-universal-rank-match] holds. No finiteness, properness, flatness, nonempty-fibre or structure-sheaf unit hypothesis is needed.

source.place: Tag 0BDP, intersection of its two fixed-rank direct-image loci; the empty-fibre rank-zero argument fills the corresponding case in the parent node lem-sc-picard-universal-rank-match-locus-lfp-core.

proof.text: For each further h and point t choose U,r and V,s from the two single-image conditions. Put W=U intersection V. Use the existing public source-library isFiniteLocallyFreeOfRank_pullback instance for ordinary pullback. Compose the adjunction comparison isomorphism with tensor-pullback composition and the open inclusion equality, then apply the existing public SheafOfModules.IsFiniteLocallyFreeOfRank.of_iso theorem to restrict each ordinary direct-image rank to W. For the reference ranks use the canonical pullback.map from X_W to X_U or X_V, and the same composite-isomorphism transport. No separate tensor-pullback rank theorem is stated or proved.
If X_W has a point, finiteLocallyFreeOfRank_stalk_finrank applied twice to its reference bundle gives r=s.

If X_W is empty, Mathlib Pullback.range_map shows that the inverse image of W in X after base change by h followed by g is empty. Restrict either ordinary direct image to W. On every affine neighbourhood its sections identify with the sections of its source module over the empty open, hence are subsingleton (source Modules.subsingleton_sections_bot). The proved source rankAtStalk_sections_eq theorem computes their constant rank, and Mathlib Module.rankAtStalk_eq_zero_of_subsingleton makes it zero. Since W contains t there is an affine neighbourhood with a prime, so r=s=0.

Replace s by r in the second restricted direct-image rank witness. W, its membership witness for t, the first and second direct-image ranks, and the reference rank give exactly PicardUniversalRankMatch. Repeat for all h,t; empty test schemes have no points to check.

proof_origin.note: X2 adaptation of the parent construction; the unit route is unchanged. Repair of the duplicate tensor_rank helper: remove it and transport ranks directly along composite isomorphisms using the existing public ordinary-pullback instance and of_iso theorem. The suggested tensorRank from PicardUniversalRankMatchConjunction is private, so it cannot be imported by its source name.

mathlib_searches.query: Two universal local finite locally free direct image rank conditions with the same reference bundle imply simultaneous common rank on one neighbourhood including empty fibres
Finite locally free ranks of two ordinary direct images can be synchronized on intersecting neighbourhoods even when the inverse image is empty
mathlib_searches.results: Eight hits: Module.isLocallyConstant_rankAtStalk_freeLocus, Module.isLocallyConstant_rankAtStalk, Module.rankAtStalk_eq_finrank_of_free, localized module finrank, Module.rankAtStalk_eq_of_equiv and tensor/product rank formulas. No two-direct-image sheaf synchronization statement.
Four Mathlib hits, all in ring-module free locus theory: rank is locally constant on the free locus. No universal sheaf direct-image rank locus or synchronization statement.
